item.title: Victory Day ‘26
item.description: May 9 is one of the most important dates on the calendar for Russians. It was on this day in 1945 that fascism in Europe was finally crushed. In the West, this historical achievement has faded. Celebrating the end of this war is no longer a high priority. In fact, there has been a long ongoing attempt to understate the role the Soviet Union played in defeating the Nazis. CrossTalking with Nicolai Petro, Constantin Von Hoffmeister, and Stevan Gajic.

item.title: CrossTalk Bullhorns: Walk away?
item.description: Fight or flight, that is the question. The Trump administration faces some very stark options as the Iran War enters its third month. Also, is the US leaving Europe militarily? If so, what are NATO’s prospects and what about the Ukraine proxy war? CrossTalking with George Szamuely and Mark Sleboda.

item.title: Calling the shots
item.description: It has become obvious that Iran has a plan to end the war of aggression it did not start. The Trump administration talks of deals. What Iran demands is a strategic solution to the region’s security crisis. Iran has the cards and allies to make this happen. CrossTalking with Daniel McAdams, Alex Reporterfy, and Fereshteh Sadeghi.

item.title: Deadlock
item.description: Has the US-Israel war of choice on Iran become a ‘forever war’ – a war that cannot be won? On this edition of CrossTalk, we examine strategy. Iran has demonstrated that it is methodical and patient. It is unclear if the Trump administration has ever had a coherent strategy. CrossTalking with Raed Jarrar, Seyed Hossein Mousavian, and Michael Scheuer.

item.title: CrossTalk Bullhorns: Decoding the ceasefire
item.description: This is where we are: The blockade is not a blockade, the ceasefire is not a ceasefire, and peace negotiations are merely a prelude to more war. We decode the rhetoric of the US-Israel war on Iran. CrossTalk with Mark Sleboda and George Szamuely.

item.title: Hormuz brinkmanship
item.description: The US and Israel have failed to achieve their war aims against Iran. In fact, Iran is still standing and forcing the Trump administration to react to its demands. The US and Israel have lost this war, can they be part of winning the peace? CrossTalking with David Swanson, Alessandro Bruno, and Scott Ritter.
